To determine the appropriate amount of water intake per day, it's best to consider individual needs based on factors such as activity level, climate, and health status. There isn't a one-size-fits-all answer for daily hydration requirements; however, general guidelines suggest drinking about 2L (about 8 glasses) of fluids per day. This figure includes water from all beverages and foods, but the number may vary depending on specific circumstances.

For more tailored advice or to address any particular health conditions, consulting with a healthcare provider is recommended.
